items.title: Reinventing software delivery with AI-SDLC on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Verisk partnered with AWS to build AI-SDLC: specialized AI agents spanning requirements, grooming, development, code review, and QA on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, with people reviewing and approving the work at each stage. See the architecture, early productivity gains, and lessons from a regulated insurance environment.
items.creator: Sajin Jacob
